latest.title: On a question by Firey concerning uniqueness
latest.abstract: We prove that the curvature equation $\sum_{j=1}^n α_j E_j(τ_{\mathcal{M}})=\sum_{j=1}^n α_j E_j(τ_{\mathcal{N}})$ yields uniqueness up to translation for any two closed $C^2_+$ hypersurfaces $\mathcal{M}, \mathcal{N}\hookrightarrow\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ whenever $(α_1,\ldots,α_n)\in\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}^n\setminus\{0\}$ is log-concave and has no internal zeros. This gives an affirmative answer to a uniqueness question posed by Firey in the $C^2_+$ class.
latest.workSummary: 对非负对数凹且无内部零的系数组合曲率方程，证明闭严格凸 C² 超曲面平移唯一性。
latest.breakthrough: 在指定 C²₊ 类和系数条件下肯定回答 Firey 唯一性问题。
latest.limitations: 不是任意系数或弱凸情形的唯一性，需回查曲率参数化。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。

latest.priorityReason: 凸性与曲率方程相关性高，系数条件的作用值得细读。
